ModMetaData.name: [EL]Stims from EFT
ModMetaData.author: Elanilda
ModMetaData.description:
添加了来自逃离塔科夫的针剂与多种便捷使用方式。 Adds stimulants from Escape from Tarkov and multiple convenient usage methods.
[功能 / Features] - 22种来自游戏《逃离塔科夫》的针剂 22 stimulant injectors from the game "Escape from Tarkov" - 涵盖止血、器官修复、镇痛、体能和感官增强等多种功能 Covers hemostasis, organ repair, analgesia, physical and sensory enhancement - 多种便捷的针剂使用方式：右键注射、殖民者互相注射、"使用针剂"能力、手术注射 Multiple convenient injection methods: right-click injection, pawn-to-pawn injection, "Use Stimulants" ability, and surgical injection - 针剂储存柜：可存放针剂与中性胺的高大冰箱，配备内容物列表标签页 Stimulant Storage: a tall cabinet for stims and neutroamine with a contents tab - 中性胺合成配方：在药物实验台将精神叶与草药加工为中性胺 Neutroamine extraction recipes: craft neutroamine from psychoid leaves and herbs at the drug lab
[使用方式 / Usage] - 选中殖民者，右键散落地面的针剂，点击"注射"即可为该殖民者注射针剂 Select a colonist, right-click a stimulant on the ground, and click "Inject" to inject it into that colonist - 殖民者携带针剂时，选中该殖民者并右键目标 pawn，可为其注射针剂。可注射对象包括殖民者、囚犯与倒地单位。 When a colonist carries stimulants, select them and right-click a target pawn to inject them. Eligible targets include colonists, prisoners, and downed pawns. - 当殖民者携带针剂并处于征召状态时，可通过"使用针剂"能力选择所携带的针剂使用 When a drafted colonist carries stimulants, use the "Use Stimulants" ability to select and use a carried stimulant - 打开“健康“界面，“手术”一栏添加“注射”手术，能以手术形式使用针剂。 Open the "Health" tab, switch to "Medical operations" and click "Add bill" to schedule an Inject surgery on a patient. - 每种针剂都能通过“方案”-“管理用药方案”来独立指定携带数量。 Each stimulant injector can be independently assigned a carry amount via Assign - Manage drug policies.
